articles.title_en: Russian drone developer seriously injured in car explosion in Yekaterinburg
articles.lead_en: Vladimir Tkachuk, CEO of Uraldronzavod and creator of the Telegram channel Povernutye na voine (“Obsessed with the war”), was injured in Yekaterinburg when his Mercedes exploded, according to the Russian business daily Kommersant and the Russian state news agency TASS.

articles.title_en: Son-in-law of Russian Aerospace Forces Commander Alexander Chayko killed in Moscow restaurant blast
articles.lead_en: Daniil Peredriy, son-in-law of Aerospace Forces Commander Alexander Chayko, was killed in the August 1 explosion at the Italian restaurant Balzi Rossi in Moscow. Leaked data from two government databases confirms his death, the independent Russian investigative outlet Agentstvo reported.
